qualification.details: Project Research Scientist – I: MBBS/BDS/BHMS/BUMS/BAMS OR Master's Degree in Epidemiology / Public Health/ Community Medicine. Experience in maintaining screening program data and sample linkage, Familiarity with diagnostic workflow documentation, Knowledge of IT applications and MS Office, Experience working in research projects, research track, scientific research publications, Data analysis and protocol writing, Skilled in using modern software and tools; possesses analytical, technical, and conceptual skills, including the preparation of reports, presentations, and persuasive documents for decision-making. Junior Research Fellow: Master's Degree in Public Health / Life Sciences / Clinical Research / Social Sciences / Epidemiology. Experience working in cancer screening or respiratory health programs, Experience supporting clinical assessment and sample documentation, Experience in maintaining participant sample records, tracking logs and record keeping, Experience in coordinating diagnostic sample workflow, Working knowledge of IT applications and MS Office, Experience in performing data entry, data cleaning, and generating queries. Project Assistant: Master's Degree in a relevant discipline of Science/ Social Sciences/Public Health. Experience supporting clinical assessment and sample documentation, Experience in maintaining participant sample records and tracking logs, Working knowledge of IT applications and MS-Office, Experience in performing data entry, data cleaning, and generating queries.

To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of AIIMS to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Research Staff recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the AIIMS Research Staff positions is August 24, 2026. Ensure you complete and submit your application before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Research Staff at AIIMS?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 vacancies for Research Staff posts announced by AIIMS, Delhi. These include positions like Project Research Scientist – I, Junior Research Fellow, and Project Assistant.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: The educational qualifications vary by post. Generally, candidates need an MBBS/BDS/BHMS/BUMS/BAMS degree or a Master's Degree in relevant fields. PhD is desirable for some positions.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to these positions?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Research Staff positions at AIIMS is up to 40 years for Project Research Scientist – I, and up to 35 years for Junior Research Fellow and Project Assistant.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Research Staff positions?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 37,000/- to Rs. 73,000/- per month, depending on the specific post. Project Research Scientist – I receives Rs. 73,000/-, Junior Research Fellow Rs. 48,000/-, and Project Assistant Rs. 37,000/-.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for AIIMS Research Staff recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the AIIMS Research Staff recruitment is strictly online. Candidates need to fill out the provided online form.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any specific application fee for this recruitment drive. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for any updates.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Research Staff positions?
faq.answer: The selection process for the AIIMS Research Staff positions will be based on a walk-in interview. Candidates shortlisted based on their applications will be called for the interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The direct link to download the official notification PDF is available in the "Important Links" section of this article. It is highly recommended to read the notification thoroughly.

faq.answer: For any queries related to the application process, candidates can contact the research project team via email at [email protected].
